A '''female Twi'lek Jedi''' engaged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] sometime before the death of his physical form in [[3996 BBY]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was killed by Kun and their duel was depicted in a [[Exar Kun fresco|fresco]] sometime later. The fresco was discovered in the catacombs beneath the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
